items.title: James Moody interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998
items.q: Look at Jerry Bergonzi. ... Oh man, isn’t he bad? But hear him man, boy I mean he’s playing some stuff

ctx.x: In medicine, in every which way. Because first of all, look at Oprah. Any time a person can’t say well oh yeah, wow, well I’ll be damned. Beef is that bad? Well you know what? I think I’ll never eat another hamburger again. That’s because she has a show and somebody — because look, twenty million people calling a television set an automobile doesn’t make it one. But, if something is good for you, and you like it, I don’t care what somebody says about it, I’m going to still do it, see? So like if beef is all that…
